# Third-party browser assets

`xlsx-0.20.3.min.js` is SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3.

- Copyright (c) 2013-present SheetJS
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt`)
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Used only to create evaluation-matrix Excel downloads in the consulting playbook.

The library is served locally so exports do not depend on a third-party CDN at
runtime. It does not receive or send readers' worksheet contents.
